items.headline: Extreme Heat Watch issued September 30 at 1:41PM PDT until October 7 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures on the
hottest days ranging from around 90 near the coast to the upper 90s
to upper 100s for the valleys possible. Low temperatures for
coastal areas into the western valleys will warm into the lower to
mid 70s during the weekend with those warm overnight temperatures
continuing for next week.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas, Orange County Inland Areas,
San Bernardino and Riverside County Valleys-The Inland Empire, San
Diego County Coastal Areas, San Diego County Valleys, and Santa Ana
Mountains and Foothills.

* WHEN...From Friday morning through Wednesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A long-duration heat wave is expected to
develop late this week and continue through much of next week into
the following weekend with Moderate or greater HeatRisk for the
coast and valleys and Major to Extreme HeatRisk for inland coastal
areas into the western valleys.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 30 at 2:02AM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected due to high tides and
high baseline water levels.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT today.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides, most likely between 11 AM and 1 PM.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides are expected to peak between
6.9 and 7.1 feet between 11 AM and 1 PM today. These tide
predictions have been corrected to reflect current trends in
observed tide observations.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
